o.text: Morphologically gözlə- (“expect”) + -nti. Likely a calque of Turkish beklenti.
Inherited from Proto-Common Turkic *bȫgček, a derivation Proto-Common Turkic *bȫg.
Borrowed from Persian گل بشکر (gol bašakar, “rose jam”).
